title: Entrance Fee Agreement Refund Terms Schedule
content:
Refund terms of the **Entrance Fee Agreement** after termination, by refund plan. The first column decides which due-date terms are used.

| Refund plan | Refund waits for re-occupancy of the apartment | Contingent refund paid within, after re-occupancy | Non-contingent refund paid within, after termination | Long-stop for any refund after termination |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| LifeChoice Declining Balance Plan | No | 30 calendar days | 60 calendar days | 24 calendar months |
| LifeChoice 50% Refundable Plan | Yes | 30 calendar days | 60 calendar days | 24 calendar months |
| LifeChoice 75% Refundable Plan | Yes | 30 calendar days | 60 calendar days | 24 calendar months |
| LifeChoice 90% Refundable Plan | Yes | 30 calendar days | 60 calendar days | 24 calendar months |
| LifeCare Declining Balance Plan | No | 30 calendar days | 60 calendar days | 24 calendar months |
| LifeCare 90% Refundable Plan | Yes | 30 calendar days | 60 calendar days | 24 calendar months |

## Terms common to all six plans

| Term | Value |
|---|---|
| Written refund calculation statement issued within | 15 calendar days after the termination date |
| Cap on deductions for refurbishment beyond normal wear and tear | 5 percent of the entrance fee |
| Letters testamentary or letters of administration required before a refund to an estate | Yes |

## Notes

- The two declining balance plans pay on a fixed period after termination; the four refundable plans with a floor wait for re-occupancy, subject to the 24 month long-stop.
